data.text:
Maa Santoshi Wshg vs State Of Orissa & Others ..... Opposite ... 
on 14 May, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 W.P. (C) No.10976 of 2024
Maa Santoshi Wshg, Puri ..... Petitioner
 Mr. K.P. Mishra, Sr. Advocate
 Vs.
State of Orissa & others ..... Opposite Parties 
 Mr. B. Panigrahi, A.S.C.
 Coram: Justice Sanjay Kumar Mishra
 Order
14.05.2024 Order No.
02.  The matter is taken up through hybrid mode. 
2. The Petitioner, which is a Women Self Help Group(WSHG), has approached this Court with a prayer for direction to re-engage the Petitioner for preparation and supply of the Take Home Ration (THR) under SNP in respect of Kanas Block in the district of Puri within a stipulated period in view of the report of the Joint Enquiry Team dated 14.08.2023, followed by the recommendation of the Collector, Puri vide Letter No.3119/SW, dated 26.10.2023, addressed to The Director, ICDS & SW Women & Child Development Deptt., Odisha, as at Annexure-3.
3. On perusal of the record, it is ascertained that pursuant to order dated 06.01.2023 passed by the coordinate Bench in W.P.(C) No.29969 of 2020, a District Level Committee was constituted consisting of Deputy Collector, Gen & Misc. Section, Collectorate, Puri, Food Safety Officer,
MOCHC, Kanas & DSWO, Puri, who enquired into the matter and submitted a satisfactory report in favour of the Petitioner SHG, there by suggesting to allow the said WSHG for preparation and supply of THR(Chhatua) and based on the said report, the Collector, Puri also communicated to the Director, ICDS & SW, Women & Child Development Deptt., Odisha vide letter dated 26.10.2023(present Opposite Party No.3) and grievance of the Petitioner is that on the said communication of the Collector, Puri, the Opposite Party No.3 is yet to act, though there is no other legal impediment. 
4. In response to said submission made by Mr. Mishra, learned Senior Counsel for the Appellant,
Mr. B. Panigrahi, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State, drawing attention of this Court to the report submitted by the Joint Enquiry Team as at Annexure-2 submits, such recommendation was made by the Joint Enquiry Team directing the present Petitioner to submit photocopy of the Food License to DSWO, Puri at an early date and no such averments have been made in the Writ Maa Santoshi Wshg vs State Of Orissa & Others ..... Opposite ... on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19396884/
1 Petition as to doing the needful in terms of the said recommendation. The concluding paragraph of the said Report being relevant, is extracted below for ready reference. 
"The enquiry Team felt that the WSHG is shorted out all the defects/shortfalls, as detected by the Dist. Level Team on dt.6.10.20 and deserves to prepare & supply THR for pregnant women, lactating mothers & children from 6 months to 6 years. The WSHG may get a chance for it with close watch on preparation & Delivery of THR food by the authorities concerned observing all formalities as per Govt. guideline. The WSHG is directed to submit the copy of food license to DSWO Puri at an early date"
(Emphasis supplied)
5. In response to the submissions made by the learned State Counsel, Mr. Mishra, learned Senior Counsel for the Petitioner submits, as per the instruction received from his client, the Petitioner-SHG has already submitted the photocopy of the Food License to DSWO, Puri. The Food License issued in favour of the Petitioner-SHG is dated 10.08.2023, which is valid till 09.08.2024 and on the very same day, the photocopy of the said License was submitted before the DSWO, Puri in terms of the direction given by the Joint Enquiry Team. 
6. In view of such submission made by the learned Senior Counsel for the Petitioner, the Opposite Party No.3- The Director, ICDS & SW Women & Child Development Deptt., Odisha is directed to act in terms of the said report so also communication made by the Collector, Puri at the earliest,
preferably within a period of six weeks from the production of the certified copy of this order,
provided there is no other legal impediment to act in terms of the said report and recommendation.
7. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands disposed of. 
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application as per rules. 
Kanhu (S.K. MISHRA)
